guide:0:0:0.text: A team that applies Tremor to improve clashes and attacks through Tremor Bursts. Choose Tremor - Scorch to turn Burn and Tremor into Wrath damage, physical Tremor around the T Corp. pair to alternate Chain and Reverb, or Tremor - Reverb through Cavernous Wailing to turn bursts into direct damage.

guide:1:0:0.text: Tremor - Scorch quickly converts Burn and Tremor, which tend to have surplus Count, into Wrath damage.

guide:1:0:1.text: Many members can bypass Stagger or heal themselves, giving the team high durability. Plenty of healing E.G.O also help against Unbreakable Coins.

guide:1:0:2.text: Dawn Office follow-ups let the team handle ordinary enemies despite appearing specialized for single targets.

guide:2:0:0.text: **Tremor - Scorch**: Combine Burn from all 3 Dawn Office members with the Thumb's Tremor. This variant has the highest damage. The Dawn Office trio must be deployed together and is Walpurgisnacht-exclusive, so choose according to your roster.

guide:2:0:1.text: **Physical Tremor**: Build around [T Corp. Class 3 VDCU Staff](persona:1113) and [T Corp. Class 3 Collection Staff](persona:0309). Against a single boss, lower enemy Clash Power with Tremor - Chain during setup, then convert to Reverb when attacking to turn bursts into direct damage.

guide:2:0:2.text: **Tremor - Reverb**: Pair Potency and Count suppliers with repeated-burst users such as [Heishou Pack - Wu Branch Adept](persona:0114) and [The Thumb East Capo IIII](persona:0512). Convert and burst through Hong Lu's [Cavernous Wailing](ego:0606). Use [Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept](persona:0212) as Faust and give her Everlasting. Slow setup and demanding play make this better for long fights against single bosses.

guide:3:0:0.text: Every member has a strong passive, so activate them early. In the Scorch variant, prioritize the 2 Dawn Office members that trigger follow-ups.

guide:3:0:1.text: Use Meursault's [Capote](ego:0504) against an enemy with some Burn already applied. It adds heavy Burn and Tremor, greatly increasing Scorch damage.

guide:3:0:2.text: [Everlasting](ego:0206) is a finisher that forces many Tremor Bursts. The Amplitude returns to its original state afterward, so prepare to convert again if the enemy survives.

guide:3:0:3.text: Scorch damage is mainly Wrath, making Rodion's [4th Match Flame](ego:0902), which applies Wrath Fragility, a strong option.

guide:4:0:0.text: The Scorch variant mainly uses Slash, and many members are weak to Blunt. Since damage is Wrath-focused, enemy Wrath resistance strongly affects the matchup.

guide:4:0:1.text: Managing both Burn and Tremor Count makes the team demanding. However, both have stable Count generation, so they are unlikely to run out once the cycle is established.
